prompt:

| Return 1m            | +6.8% |
| Return 1w            | +10.8% |
| Range position (63d) | 100% |
| 21d realized vol     | 40% |
| Last close           | 84.35 |

raw_response:

With a last close of 84.35 and a relatively modest realized volatility (21d at 40%), the favorable trend appears likely to persist over the next few weeks. The complete range history (63d 100% range position) suggests room to trend if catalysts emerge, supporting a constructive near-term stance.

DECISION: BUY
